purpose: Teach: 一人ひとり/要注意/停電/クッション/ワンピース/落ち込む/ねぎ/玉ねぎ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、お客様、本気で、絶対、一人ひとり、絶対、大切にしてるわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious—I treasure every single one of my customers. Every one.
lines.style: Warm, direct eye contact. Slight emphasis on 「大切に」 with genuine conviction. Soft, unhurried pace. Speaking from the heart without performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、横断歩道、本気で、絶対、要注意、絶対、だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious—I really watch carefully when I cross the street.
lines.style: Solemn, earnest. Small voice but certain. Eyes serious. Pause before 「要注意」 like he's making a promise.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、本気で、絶対、停電、絶対、対策、絶対、してるわよ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious—my shop has a real backup plan for blackouts.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, reassuring. Practical tone. Quick, efficient delivery. Not worried, just prepared. Nods slightly as if checking off a list.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、クッション、絶対、ふかふかだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious—my cushion is really, really soft.
lines.style: Eager, bright. Small laugh underneath. Leans forward slightly. Quick tempo, words tumbling out with childlike excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、ワンピース、絶対、新しいの、絶対、買ったの
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious—I just bought a brand new dress.
lines.style: Bright, animated. A little proud. Lighter, lifted at the end like sharing good news. Tempo quick, engaged.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テストで、本気で、絶対、落ち込む、絶対、ことあるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious—I do feel down sometimes when I don't do well on a test.
lines.style: Quiet admission underneath the surface. A small, wry half-smile. Vulnerable but matter-of-fact. Slight trailing off, like he's admitting something he doesn't usually say.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、本気で、絶対、ねぎ、絶対、トッピング、絶対、人気よ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious—the green onion topping at my shop is really popular.
lines.style: Proud, light. A touch of warmth and amusement. Animated, upbeat delivery. Speaking about something she cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、玉ねぎ、絶対、お料理、絶対、頑張って食べてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm serious—I'm really trying hard to eat the onions even though it's difficult.
lines.style: Determined, earnest. Slight strain in the voice—effort visible. Close and confiding, like sharing a small struggle. Genuine attempt at seriousness mixed with childlike determination.
